title: Learn from the Gap: Differential-Aware Advantage Pruning with Adaptive Rollout Sampling for GRPO
abstract: arXiv:2609.36932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and its variants have been developed for policy optimization and demonstrated notable performance gains. However, these methods usually incur substantial computational overhead due to per-question multi-rollout sampling and repeated per-token probability evaluation across rollouts. Furthermore, low-information or highly homogeneous trajectories can degrade downstream learning signal efficiency, hindering model optimization and limiting final performance. translated_title: 从差距中学习：面向GRPO的差分感知优势剪枝与自适应Rollout采样
translated_abstract: 近年来，组相对策略优化（GRPO）及其变体被开发用于策略优化，并展现出显著的性能提升。然而，这些方法通常由于每个问题需要多次rollout采样以及跨rollout重复进行逐token概率评估，而产生大量计算开销。此外，低信息量或高度同质化的轨迹会降低下游学习信号的效率，阻碍模型优化并限制最终性能。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FastRL，一种新颖的即插即用强化学习框架，可同时提升训练效率与策略学习的有效性。具体而言：1）我们引入了一种优势感知的剪枝策略，在最大化轨迹间梯度多样性的同时，选择性地保留高优势轨迹；2）随后，我们设计了一种自适应rollout采样机制，以动态调整采样过程（摘要内容在此截断）。
tldr: 提出即插即用的FastRL强化学习框架，通过差分感知的优势剪枝自适应保留高价值轨迹并最大化梯度多样性，同时结合自适应rollout采样机制，显著提升GRPO的训练效率与策略学习效果。
en_tdlr: FastRL is a plug-and-play RL framework for GRPO that combines differential-aware advantage pruning with adaptive rollout sampling to cut computational overhead while preserving high-advantage trajectories and maximizing gradient diversity.
